ownership_boundary.m1_owns: versioned external types, semantic owners, required fields, forbidden material, and fail-closed invariants
ownership_boundary.m2_owns: physical persistence, transaction boundaries, repository ports, indexes, lease/retry state machine, shadow execution, parity evidence, rollback implementation, quarantine storage, and cutover
ownership_boundary.no_runtime_claim: This artifact contains no live manifest, store read, migration, parity result, cutover, or rollback-ready claim.

invariants: There is one declared primary truth owner at a time.
A shadow failure never redirects or silently replaces the primary write.
Every shadow attempt retains command receipt, audit record, and correlation chain references.
Unknown, corrupt, sensitive, or unjoinable input is blocked or quarantined by reference.
No destructive cleanup occurs before semantic parity, rollback proof, and a separately accepted cutover package.

classification_rules.corrupt: BLOCK_OR_QUARANTINE_REF_ONLY; preserve value-free provenance and reason
classification_rules.sensitive: SCRUB_AND_STOP_BEFORE_ORDINARY_STORE; never copy the original value
classification_rules.approved_difference: requires named owner, reason, expected canonical result, and accepted receipt
classification_rules.bug: parity remains HOLD until fixed and rerun

rollback_guards: Rollback is non-destructive and retains the last known primary position plus shadow evidence.
Rollback never replays a command without original idempotency, correlation, and causation keys.
Rollback blocks on unresolved quarantine, join, or redaction violations.
Each domain cutover has an independent rollback owner and accepted runtime package.
User-visible cutover and deletion require later explicit authorization.
